project_metadata.title: Real-time Speech Translation Platform Analysis
project_metadata.description: Systematic literature review analyzing architectural patterns, design considerations, and performance optimization strategies for real-time speech translation platforms
project_metadata.primary_research_question: What are the key architectural patterns, design considerations, and performance optimization strategies for implementing effective real-time speech translation platforms?

research_framework.Population: Real-time speech translation platforms and systems
research_framework.Intervention: Various architectural approaches, design patterns, optimization techniques
research_framework.Comparison: Different platform implementations, performance metrics, accuracy measures
research_framework.Outcome: System performance, translation accuracy, user experience, scalability

databases: IEEE Xplore - Technical papers and conference proceedings
ACM Digital Library - Computer science research
arXiv - Recent preprints and technical reports

inclusion: Academic papers on real-time speech translation systems (2015-2025)
exclusion: Papers older than 10 years (unless seminal works)

deliverables: Systematic review report following PRISMA guidelines
Architecture pattern taxonomy for speech translation platforms
Performance benchmark comparison across different systems
Best practices guide for real-time translation system design
